description: Regression: a type:number field with NO rules must still run implicit number validation. Before the fix JS returned early on the `!fieldSpec.rules` guard and skipped the implicit check, while PHP (Validator.php:290) and Go ran it regardless of rules. Note: legacy had no implicit number at all; this is an intentional strengthening so the client is never looser than the server. Empty values are skipped (required handles them).

tests.description: type:number, no rules object at all: non-numeric input is invalid via implicit number
type:number with no rules nested inside a group: implicit number still fires
